judged_text: Google event creation for legacy destination calendars with an `externalId` but no `credentialId` falls back across credentials but cannot select the destination calendar, defaulting to `"primary"`.

record.issue_text: Google event creation for legacy destination calendars with an `externalId` but no `credentialId` falls back across credentials but cannot select the destination calendar, defaulting to `"primary"`.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in GoogleCalendarService.ts, the createEvent method now receives a credentialId parameter and uses it to find the matching destination calendar: `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`. However, in the fallback path in EventManager.ts (lines 375-379), when there's no credentialId on the destination, it calls `createEvent(c, event)` without passing an externalId. The createEvent function in CalendarManager.ts then passes this undefined externalId to the calendar service. In GoogleCalendarService, when credentialId doesn't match any destination calendar (which would happen for legacy calendars that have externalId but no credentialId), the find() returns undefined, so selectedCalendar becomes undefined, falling back to 'primary'. This means legacy destination calendars with externalId but no credentialId will incorrectly create events in the primary calendar instead of the specified destination calendar.
